engine.summary: {player} vs {enemy} is a {role} matchup. Respect {enemyName}'s spikes, counter their damage type and punish their cooldowns.
engine.itemReasonAd: Armor reduces {enemyName}'s physical damage output in every trade.
engine.itemReasonAp: Magic resist shrinks {enemyName}'s burst and poke damage.
engine.itemReasonHealing: {enemyName} heals or sustains — Grievous Wounds cuts their recovery.
engine.itemReasonCC: {enemyName} brings heavy crowd control — tenacity shortens every lockdown.
engine.itemReasonBoots: Boots first: movement speed dodges {enemyName}'s key skillshots and helps you trade back.
engine.avoidReasonAd: Magic resist does nothing against {enemyName}'s physical damage.
engine.avoidReasonAp: Armor does nothing against {enemyName}'s magic damage.
engine.avoidReasonHealing: Raw damage doesn't help when {enemyName} heals it back — buy healing reduction instead.
engine.runeReasonCC: {enemyName} locks you down — Legend: Tenacity shrinks their crowd control windows.
engine.runeReasonDefault: Your standard page already covers this matchup's damage profile.
engine.spellReasonDefault: Your default summoner spell setup fits this matchup.
engine.spikeLevel: Level {level} unlocks a new ability — use the window before {enemyName} answers it.
engine.spikeItem: Your {item} purchase turns fights in your favor. Force an objective or a trade immediately.
engine.spikeLate: Full build: teamfights decide the game. Group with your team and play the objective timers.
engine.windowDodge: {ability} is {enemyName}'s biggest threat. Track the cooldown and stay out of its effective range.
engine.windowPunish: When {ability} is down, {enemyName} is at their weakest — all-in or zone them completely.
engine.windowCounter: Save your key cooldown to answer {ability} and turn {enemyName}'s engage around.
engine.waveDefault: Manage the wave near your tower: {enemyName} punishes overextension, and a controlled wave keeps gank angles open.
engine.waveTop: Freeze near your tower and force {enemyName} to overextend for CS. Crash before you roam to objectives.
engine.waveJungle: Track {enemyName}'s pathing and contest scuttles with lane priority. Counter-gank their weak side.
engine.waveMid: Shove and roam — first to river wins the fight. Ward both sides against {enemyName}'s roams.
engine.waveBot: Slow-push and crash waves before dragon spawns. Punish {enemyName} every time they walk up for a last hit.
engine.waveSupport: Control the river bushes and poke at the bounce point. Roam mid after every crash while your carry farms safely.
